description: Java source code for the SmsApiResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing SMS messages within the Fineract platform, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion of SMS data.

classes.name: SmsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for SMS management, providing endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting SMS messages.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all SMS data entries, with permission check.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new SMS entry based on the provided request data.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific SMS data entry by its resource ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllSmsByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves SMS data entries filtered by campaign ID and status, with optional date range and pagination.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing SMS entry identified by resource ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an SMS entry identified by resource ID.
